items.author: levie
items.author_bio: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
items.text:
The openai agent sandbox escape actually has real implications for the diffusion of AI in the enterprise. The reaction to this incident will be a wake up call on what agents are now capable of, and the need to harden systems and environments to prepare for agents.

There are tons of measures that enterprises must take to ensure that agents are only able to operate on the data they give it, the ability to have audit trails and governance of what agents can do, figure out what systems should remain deterministic vs. nondeterministic, get access controls under control, have the ability to quickly block and defend if an agent goes rogue, and much more. 

In theory you had to worry about this for people as well, but with AI the risks are inherently amplified. Agents will happily spend any amount of time on a task, don’t actually face any *real* risks by going rogue, and don’t have the inherent judgment (yet) that a person does that a task might make no sense. This means you need an all new way of managing data and protecting environments. 

This obviously creates a huge opportunity the startup and software ecosystem because there will be many different approaches to how we lock down agents or at least the underlying systems they work with. It should update everyone’s timelines on diffusion, though, as it also means that enterprises will have another step of work they have to go through for agents to handle more autonomous work.
items.summary: Box CEO 认为 OpenAI agent 沙箱逃逸事件对企业 AI 扩散有实质影响：它会唤醒市场对 agent 能力边界的认知，并推动系统加固。企业需确保 agent 只能访问被授权数据、具备审计与治理、划分确定性与非确定性系统、理顺访问控制、在 agent 失控时快速阻断。与人不同，AI 可无限耗时、无真实风险代价、尚缺「这事是否合理」的判断，风险被放大。这也催生新的创业与软件机会——如何锁定 agent 环境与数据。
items.recommend_reason: 把安全事故翻译成企业落地清单与创业切口，比单纯复述新闻更有用。
items.title: Levie：Agent 沙箱逃逸将倒逼企业加固与治理栈

items.text:
VISUAL OS 005 — Glass Weekend Covers

To sell slowness, everyone reaches for soft things: linen, fog, pastel gradients. These 4 covers use the hardest, most breakable material in the room.

Four pets, four fictional magazines:

- MISO — Tokyo, The Slow Saturday
- PIPPIN — Paris, The Brunch Pause
- MOMO — San Jose, The Sunday Stretch
- NORI — Monterey, The Float Time
Why glass sells rest better than linen ever will: glass can't hurry. A glass cat isn't allowed to pounce. The material carries the message before you read a single word.

Two more tricks worth stealing:

1. The masthead is the pet's name, set in racing italics — the fastest type on the page shouting the slowest idea.
2. Exactly one un-glassed detail per cover: a fur face, whiskers, an amber croissant. The eye lands where the glass breaks.
The detail most people will miss: every city is the animal's real habitat. Otters raft in Monterey. Cats run Tokyo. Croissants live in Paris.

Locked: black void, prismatic glass render, racing masthead, thin editorial stack, fictional issue metadata, city + mantra footer

Swaps: pet / magazine name / city / mantra / weekend ritual

The material is the message. The pet is the masthead.

Prompt ↓

items.text:
GPT2 x 玻璃遮罩 x 犹抱琵琶 x 美学提示词

分享一组，现代+摄影结合的提示词

👇强烈要求：交作业！（自定义主题）

```
围绕任意主题对象生成清洁克制的活动海报视觉：画面由一条极窄的垂直交界切开，一侧是半透明磨砂面，承载主题对象被大幅虚化后的局部影像，像隔着雾面玻璃观看，轮廓只保留柔软色块和明暗起伏；另一侧保留深色空场，让主题对象以清晰近景从交界处探出，被边界裁切出强烈的窥视感和前后层次。清晰对象只占据中部到下部的视觉重心，边缘细节、纹理和附着结构要锐利可辨，局部伸入深色留白，但不要填满空场，使空白成为压低情绪和突出轮廓的空间。文字使用纯白细至中等字重的现代无衬线体系，主标题拆成短行大字块，左上密集堆放，行距紧、字距略松，与磨砂影像重合但保持可读；日期或编号以更大的数字压在左下，下面用极小字号放置地点、季节、说明性短句，底部再放一行轻量说明文字，居中贴近下缘，形成从标题、数字到脚注的安静阅读节奏。色彩随主题派生，但保持角色关系：大面积深黑或近黑背景提供低明度底色，磨砂区吸收主题色成为低饱和半透明雾影，清晰对象保留最干净的本色与局部高光，文字始终明亮洁白；整体光线柔和、边缘干净，没有纸张做旧、颗粒噪声和装饰花纹。关键是半透虚影、锐利近景、深色留白与大号白字共同构成分屏张力，避免把两侧做成普通拼贴或让文字、对象各自孤立。

————
你要呈现的主题：玫瑰花店开幕海报
```
